lead.tldr: U.S. attack on Iran surges oil prices and plunges Dow futures risking Strait of Hormuz disruptions. • South Korea reviews seized crypto custody after tax office seed phrase leak loses 4 million tokens. • Aave DAO proposal passes temp check redirecting revenue to treasury and advancing V4 plans. • Crypto scams and hacks drop to 35.7 million in February lowest since March 2025. • JPMorgan forecasts U.S. crypto market structure bill approval by mid-year as positive catalyst. • Bitcoin traders eye new lows despite limited Iran conflict impact on crypto markets.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Geopolitical tensions spike oil prices after U.S. attack on Iran. South Korea reviews seized crypto custody post seed phrase leak. Aave DAO advances revenue shift and V4 while hacks drop sharply.

top_signals.title: Dow futures plunge nearly 500 points as U.S. attack on Iran sends oil prices soaring, while first American casualties reported
top_signals.summary: Dow futures plunged nearly 500 points after U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iranian facilities prompted Iran to warn shipping away from the Strait of Hormuz. Insurers withdrew coverage, halting tanker traffic through this critical chokepoint that carries 15-20% of global oil supply, or about 20 million barrels per day. This real-time supply shock renders much of OPEC+ spare capacity inaccessible, as bypass routes like Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and UAE's Fujairah line offer only partial mitigation of around 5-7 million barrels per day. Institutional investors face heightened volatility with oil prices potentially exceeding $100 per barrel amid escalating conflict risks.

top_signals.title: South Korea Orders Review After Tax Office Seed Phrase Leak
top_signals.summary: South Korea is reviewing its seized asset wallets after the tax agency leaked a seed phrase, resulting in the loss of 4 million PRTG tokens. The deputy PM announced a sweep of seized asset wallets following the incident.

top_signals.title: South Korea finance minister pledges review of seized crypto custody after recovery phrase leak
top_signals.summary: South Korea's Finance Minister Koo Yun-cheol announced an urgent review of how public institutions manage seized cryptocurrencies following a recovery phrase leak. The review aims to improve security and custody practices for seized crypto assets.

top_signals.title: 'Aave will win' proposal clears temp check with 52.6% backing on revenue shift, V4 plan
top_signals.summary: Aave DAO's proposal to redirect product revenue to the treasury and ratify V4 as a strategic foundation has passed a temperature check with 52.6% support. This indicates a shift in Aave's governance and future development direction.

top_signals.title: Crypto Scams and Hacks Drop Sharply in February, PeckShield
top_signals.summary: Crypto scams and hacks decreased significantly in February, with losses falling to $35.7 million, the lowest since March 2025, according to PeckShield. YieldBlox and IoTeX accounted for more than half of the total losses.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan says crypto market structure bill could be approved by mid-year and serve as positive catalyst in second half
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan analysts believe that the U.S. market structure legislation for crypto could be approved by mid-year, potentially acting as a positive catalyst for the market in the second half of the year.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin lays out a two-part plan to overhaul Ethereum's execution layer from the ground up
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin has proposed a two-part plan to overhaul Ethereum's execution layer. The proposal includes a binary tree implementation and a VM transition, with the former being more concrete and the latter more speculative.

top_signals.title: At least 22 people killed and more than 120 injured in Pakistan after Iran supporters try to storm U.S. Consulate
top_signals.summary: At least 22 people were killed and over 120 injured in Pakistan after supporters of Iran attempted to storm the U.S. Consulate in Karachi. Protesters briefly attacked the consulate's perimeter before being dispersed by police.

top_signals.title: ‘Vibe-coding 2030 roadmap within weeks’ – Buterin’s new Ethereum vision
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin is reportedly working on a 2030 roadmap for Ethereum, with agentic coding experiments accelerating development timelines.

top_signals.title: Aave Proposal Clears First Hurdle After Split Vote
top_signals.summary: An Aave proposal to allocate up to $42.5M and 75,000 AAVE tokens to Aave Labs in exchange for routing product revenue to the DAO treasury has cleared its first hurdle after a split vote. The framework aims to benefit the DAO treasury.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Traders Warn of New Lows as BTC Weathers Iran Storm
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin traders are anticipating potential new lows for BTC despite the limited immediate impact of the Iran situation. The market is bracing for possible further downside.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, In a world of escalating traditional market shocks, blockchain's resilience shines brighter than ever. Dow futures plunged nearly 500 points as U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iranian facilities triggered Iran's warnings on Strait of Hormuz shipping, with insurers pulling coverage and halting tanker traffic through this vital chokepoint for 15-20% of global oil, or 20 million barrels daily. Limited bypass options like Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and UAE's Fujairah line cover just 5-7 million barrels per day, leaving institutional investors bracing for oil above $100 per barrel and rampant volatility. At Blockwall, we see these macro tremors as a stark reminder: decentralized technologies offer the stability and borderless access traditional systems lack. Closer to home, South Korea's tax agency suffered a major wake-up call with a leaked seed phrase, resulting in the loss of 4 million PRTG tokens from seized asset wallets. Finance Minister Koo Yun-cheol swiftly pledged an urgent review of public institutions' crypto custody practices to bolster security. Deputy PM announcements followed with a full sweep of seized wallets. These incidents underscore a critical truth for Web3 builders: ironclad custody and self-sovereign security are non-negotiable as governments grapple with crypto's realities. As Europe's leading crypto VC, we're doubling down on founders pioneering secure infrastructure like Validation Cloud's enterprise-grade node management and Spiko's tokenized money market funds. In turbulent times, blockchain isn't just an asset class, it's the antifragile backbone of tomorrow's economy. What steps is your team taking to fortify against real-world volatility and custody risks? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
